operations.command: cd /etc/nixos && NIX_CONFIG='experimental-features = nix-command flakes' nix-shell shell.nix --run 'make build' >/tmp/nixosctl-build.log 2>&1 && printf built || { tail -40 /tmp/nixosctl-build.log; exit 1; }

cd /etc/nixos && printf 'n\n' | NIX_CONFIG='experimental-features = nix-command flakes' ./build/nixosctl install --format --yes >/tmp/nixosctl-install.log 2>&1 && printf installed || { tail -60 /tmp/nixosctl-install.log; exit 1; }

set -e; test -f /mnt/etc/nixos/flake.nix; btrfs subvolume list /mnt | grep -F '@snapshots/@root/CLEAN' >/dev/null; btrfs subvolume list /mnt | grep -F '@snapshots/@home/CLEAN' >/dev/null; printf clean-snapshots
set -e; findmnt -rn --target /etc/nixos | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos' >/dev/null; test -f /etc/nixos/flake.nix; printf persisted-config
